entities.name: Goldilocks
entities.look: A seven-year-old girl with fair skin, rosy cheeks, bright brown eyes, and thick golden ringlets tied with a sky-blue ribbon; she wears a sky-blue pinafore over a yellow long-sleeved dress, white stockings, and brown ankle boots.

entities.name: The Three Bears
entities.look: Three friendly upright brown bears, always shown together. Father Bear is broad and tall, twice Baby Bear's height, with dark brown fur, a cream shirt, and a forest-green waistcoat. Mother Bear is four-fifths Father's height, with warm chestnut fur, a burgundy dress, and a cream apron. Baby Bear is small and round, with honey-brown fur, mustard-yellow overalls, and a teal neckerchief.

entities.name: Wooden Porridge Spoon
entities.look: A child-hand-length walnut-brown wooden spoon with a shallow oval bowl, a rounded handle, and a small carved leaf at the handle's end.

locations.name: The Woodland Cottage
locations.look: An empty woodland clearing viewed from a fixed wide, eye-level three-quarter establishing angle facing the cottage's front and left side. A small cream-plastered cottage fills the middle background, with a mossy red-tiled roof, a stone chimney, and an open oak front door on the right half of its facade. A forked dirt path leads from the doorstep toward the woods at left and toward the lower-right foreground. Fixed flower beds border the walls; tall leafy trees frame the clearing in gentle morning light.

locations.name: The Porridge Room
locations.look: An empty rustic dining room viewed from a fixed wide, slightly elevated establishing angle from the front-left corner toward the back wall. A broad oak table occupies the centre, with clear standing space behind it. Along its near edge sit three stationary porridge bowls: a large pale-blue bowl at left, a medium rose-pink bowl in the centre, and a small butter-yellow bowl at right. Initially all three are full; only the large bowl gives off visible steam. A square window is centred on the back wall, an open doorway stands at back right, and a stone hearth occupies the left wall. Honey-coloured floorboards and warm daylight remain unchanged.

locations.name: The Three Chairs
locations.look: An empty cottage sitting room viewed from a fixed wide, eye-level establishing angle facing the back wall. Three stationary chairs stand side by side across the middle of the room: a very large dark-oak chair with a hard flat seat at left, a medium rose-upholstered armchair with deeply sagging cushions in the centre, and a small honey-coloured wooden chair with thin spindle legs at right. A braided oval rug lies beneath them. A stone fireplace is set into the left wall, a small window is on the back wall, and an open doorway is at far right. Gentle daylight fills the room.

locations.name: The Three Beds
locations.look: An empty cottage bedroom viewed from a fixed wide, slightly elevated establishing angle from the foot-end wall toward the headboards. Three stationary beds run side by side, their headboards against the back wall and their feet toward the foreground: a very large dark-oak bed with a taut green quilt at left, a medium bed with a plump mattress and rose quilt in the centre, and a small honey-coloured bed with a blue-and-yellow patchwork quilt at right. Each has one white pillow. An open doorway occupies the left wall near the foreground, and a small back-wall window admits soft daylight. The quilts are initially neatly spread.

The three bears left their hot porridge and walked into the woods together. Goldilocks found their cottage and slipped inside.

Soft-gouache storybook illustration; warm woodland palette; gentle daylight; expressive, friendly faces; no lettering; 16:9 film still.
With the wooden spoon, she tasted Father's porridge: too hot! Mother's was too cold. Baby's was just right; she ate it all.
